dz: 西班牙国王腓力五世颁布加泰罗尼亚公国新普兰塔法令,废除了加泰罗尼亚机构及其法律制度,取而代之的是卡斯蒂利亚机构,从而结束了加泰罗尼亚作为单独一州的统治,并成为了法国式的新西班牙王国的一个行省.
de: King Philip V of Spain promulgates the Nueva Planta decree of the Principality of Catalonia, abolishing the Catalan institutions and its legal system, being replaced by those of Castile, thus putting an end to Catalonia as separate state and becoming a province of the new French-style Kingdom of Spain.
